scenario.title: Path claims, work lanes and collisions
situations: Two items need the same file.
Implementation discovers an additional required file.
A claim/boundary refusal stops an otherwise necessary change.
scenario.current: Research trace; requirements and source paths need live proof.
questions: Overlap procedure and current override source were inspected, but collision/authorization scenarios were not executed.
Verify each scope expansion/refusal routes to current registered commands and never recommends dropping required work.
Command nodes, when present, were checked with installed CLI --help only; this proves parser/help availability, not serving-control-plane capability or successful execution.

lessons.title: Explain coordination, preserve scope
lessons.when: When a survey, declaration or implementation change reveals overlapping physical edit paths.
lessons.need: A path claim records coordination over physical files; it does not justify omitting a necessary file. Independent edits can be attested; ordered edits wait directionally.
lessons.surface: Agent operation home; Idea/Refine overlap classification; Frontier blockers
lessons.gap: Human discovery is mainly a failure/blocker. Review question: should the first concurrent-work proposal explain only the actual overlap and chosen coordination, with depth linked?

lessons.title: Route repair to its owner
lessons.when: At a claim registration/widening/boundary refusal or an irreducible overlap requiring escalation.
lessons.need: Read both specs and overlap evidence; use authoring classification and sanctioned scope amendment. Resolve the current override authority before teaching or taking a last-resort collision override.
lessons.surface: Claim conflict procedure; override implementation; older internal operator guide
lessons.gap: Internal guide labels override human-only and includes old direct-client recipes; current override implementation describes a covering live steering seat. Review question: which current authority governs, and which public/private producers must be reconciled before promoting this guide?
